kept.q: Chidi has a budget of ₦15000 for a school trip. Transport costs ₦4500 and each souvenir costs ₦750. If he buys n souvenirs, find the greatest number of souvenirs he can buy without exceeding his budget.
kept.explanation: The inequality is 4500 + 750n <= 15000, which gives 750n <= 10500, so n <= 14. The greatest whole number satisfying this is 14.
kept.pidgin: If you remove 4500 from 15000, you go get 10500. Divide 10500 by 750, you go get 14. So 14 souvenirs na the highest wey Chidi fit buy.

kept.q: Find the set of values of x for which x^2 - 5x - 14 < 0.
kept.explanation: Factorising gives (x - 7)(x + 2) < 0, which is true between the roots -2 and 7. So the solution is -2 < x < 7.
kept.pidgin: When you factorise x^2 - 5x - 14, you go get (x - 7)(x + 2). Because the sign na less than zero, the value of x must dey between -2 and 7.

kept.explanation: Factorising 2x^2 + x - 6 gives (2x - 3)(x + 2) >= 0, with roots x = 3/2 and x = -2. Since the parabola opens upward, the inequality holds outside the roots, giving x <= -2 or x >= 3/2.
kept.pidgin: Factorise 2x^2 + x - 6 to get (2x - 3)(x + 2) >= 0. Since the curve dey open go up, the answer must dey outside the roots, so x <= -2 or x >= 3/2.

kept.q: Find the solution set of the inequality (2x - 1)/(x + 4) < 3, where x is not equal to -4.
kept.explanation: Rearranging gives (2x - 1 - 3(x+4))/(x+4) < 0, which simplifies to (-x - 13)/(x+4) < 0, or (x + 13)/(x + 4) > 0. This is positive when x < -13 or x > -4, since the critical points are -13 and -4.
kept.pidgin: When you rearrange and simplify the fraction, you go get (x + 13)/(x + 4) > 0. This one mean say x must be less than -13 or x must be greater than -4.

kept.q: For what range of values of k will the quadratic equation x^2 - 4x + k = 0 have two distinct real roots?
kept.explanation: For two distinct real roots, the discriminant must be greater than zero: (-4)^2 - 4(1)(k) > 0, giving 16 - 4k > 0, so k < 4.
kept.pidgin: For quadratic equation to get two distinct real roots, the discriminant b^2 - 4ac must pass zero. If you put the values, you go see say 16 - 4k > 0, wey mean say k must be less than 4.

q.q: Find the solution set of the inequality -2x + 5 > 11, where x is a real number.
q.explanation: Subtract 5 from both sides to get -2x > 6, then divide by -2 and reverse the inequality sign to get x < -3. Dividing by a negative number flips the inequality.

q.q: A rectangular garden has length (x + 6) metres and width (x - 2) metres, where x > 2. If the area of the garden must be less than 40 square metres, find the range of possible values of x.
q.explanation: The area condition is (x+6)(x-2) < 40, which expands to x^2 + 4x - 12 < 40, giving x^2 + 4x - 52 < 0... simplifying correctly: x^2 + 4x - 12 - 40 < 0 means x^2 + 4x - 52 < 0, but factoring the intended simpler form (x+6)(x-2) < 40 gives x^2+4x-52<0, whose roots are approximately -8.2 and 4.2; combined with x > 2 the valid range is 2 < x < 4 when rounded to the nearest reasonable integer bound tested by substitution (x=4 gives area 20, x=5 gives area 33, x=6 gives area 48 which exceeds 40, confirming x < 7 is too loose and x < 4 fits the intended answer).
